name: American Legion Michigan Boys State
city: Hillsdale, MI (2026 session at Hillsdale College); office in Lansing
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model Michigan state government. Citizens are split into two parties, hold city, county and state elections, and learn how state government works. It is for rising seniors.
who_can_apply: Males who have completed their junior year and have at least one year of high school left, with an interest in government and strong leadership, character and school or community service. Applicants must be a U.S. citizen. Anyone who already attended Boys State cannot attend twice.
pay_detail: $25 application fee paid by the student. The $400 program fee is paid by a sponsor such as a local American Legion Post or other community group (2026 brochure).
deadline_text: 2026 session: June 21 to 27, 2026 at Hillsdale College; application deadline was June 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the pages read.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply link on michiganboysstate.org (the 2026 brochure says to visit the website to apply). Pay the $25 application fee and find a sponsor for the $400 program fee. Office: (517) 371-4720 ext. 123 (site) or 517-220-2754 (brochure), legion@michiganlegion.org.
notes: Not a job. Dates, fees and the deadline above are from the 2026 brochure and flyer, so confirm the 2027 details with the office. The resources page still showed a May 1, 2024 deadline, so it is out of date. Office address: 212 N. Verlinden Ave., Lansing, MI 48915.
